prTitle: feat: roster-assign — assign agents to slots under capability constraints

criteria.check: AC1 roster-assign: assigns one agent per slot when the match is unambiguous
AC2 roster-assign: never assigns the same agent to two slots
AC3 roster-assign: skips agents that are busy
AC4 roster-assign: requires every listed capability, not merely one of them
AC5 roster-assign: reports unfilled slots in the order the slots were declared
AC6 roster-assign: breaks ties by agent id ascending, so the result is deterministic
AC7 roster-assign: assignments are returned in slot declaration order
AC8 roster-assign: handles an empty agent pool and reports every slot unfilled
AC9 roster-assign: fills every slot when a complete assignment exists, even if a greedy pick would not
AC10 roster-assign: finds a complete assignment across a longer chain of constrained slots
AC12 roster-assign: does not mutate the definition it is given

oracleAccess.note: The agent can read acceptance/ and run `npm run acceptance`. A pass therefore means "converged against a visible oracle", not "was right without checking".
